app.title: Pi 5 Fan Control
app.subtitle: Raspberry Pi 5 Active Cooler
history.title: History
control.title: Control
control.manualHint: Used in manual mode. Emergency and override protections still apply.
boost.title: Boost
boost.hint: Run the fan at full speed for a short time.
curve.title: Fan curve
curve.hint: Drag points to edit. Double-click empty space to add a point, double-click a point to remove it.
safety.title: Protection
safety.emergency_temp.hint: Full speed in every mode at or above this temperature.
safety.manual_override_temp.hint: Above this, manual mode is never slower than the curve.
safety.hysteresis.hint: How far the temperature must drop below a threshold before slowing down.
safety.min_change_interval.hint: Minimum time between automatic slow-downs, one level at a time.
safety.stall_detection.hint: Raise an alarm if the fan should spin but reports 0 RPM.
safety.spinup_kick.hint: Briefly run at full speed when starting from standstill.
backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Download or restore the full configuration as JSON.
events.title: Events
event.stopping: Fan control stopping, fan handed back to the kernel
event.sensor_failure: Temperature sensor failed, fan at full speed
alarm.emergency: Emergency cooling: the SoC reached {temp} °C. The fan runs at full speed until it cools down.
alarm.sensor_failure: The temperature sensor cannot be read. The fan is held at full speed for safety.
alarm.fan_stall: The fan reports 0 RPM at level {level}. Check the fan cable and that nothing blocks the blades.
alarm.manual_override: Manual level is too low for {temp} °C; following the curve until it cools down.
alarm.control_shared: The kernel thermal governor could not be switched off, so the panel keeps re-applying the fan level.
errors.invalid_seconds: Duration must be between {min} and {max} seconds.
errors.curve_empty: The curve needs at least one point.
errors.curve_too_many: The curve can have at most {max} points.
errors.curve_not_monotonic: The fan level may not decrease as the temperature rises.
errors.override_above_emergency: The manual override temperature must not exceed the emergency temperature.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
